ARBC 101.title: Beginning Classical and Quranic Arabic I
ARBC 101.description: Classical Arabic, with an introduction to vocabulary and grammar and the reading of simple Qur'anic texts and wisdom sayings in the original.

ARBC 205.title: Beginning Classical and Quranic Arabic II
ARBC 205.description: Classical Arabic, with further introduction to vocabulary and grammar and the reading of Qur'anic texts in the original.

ARBC 301.title: Intermediate Classical and Quranic Arabic I
ARBC 301.description: Classical Arabic. Designed to enrich vocabulary and grammar and to enhance fluency in reading and interpreting a range of Qur'anic texts.

ARBC 302.title: Intermediate Classical and Quranic Arabic II
ARBC 302.description: Classical Arabic. Designed to further enrich vocabulary and grammar and to enhance fluency in reading and interpreting longer texts from Qur'an, Hadith and other genres.

ARBC 420.title: Supervised Study in Classical and Quranic Arabic
ARBC 420.description: Readings in religious and literary Arabic texts pertaining to the early and classical Islamic world.
